# Hey, I'm Frost 👋

I'm a TypeScript developer building full-stack web apps and
exploring AI tools. I care about how software works, looks,
and feels.

### 🔭 Currently Exploring

- **Software design** — Organizing code into clear, maintainable modules.
- **AI & Agents** — Understanding how coding agents work and experimenting
  with agent workflows.
- **Developer tools** — Improving my everyday workflow and tinkering
  with my terminal setup.
